templates.title: ADHX
templates.description: Keep the posts you and your friends love from X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and ten more networks, and find any of them by describing what you remember.
templates.note: Open http://<this machine>:3000 once it's running and enter the setup code to become the owner. Needs about 2 GB of memory.

env.name: SETUP_CODE
env.label: Setup code
env.description: Any phrase. You type it once, on the first screen, to become the owner. Leave it empty to read it from the stack's log.

env.name: APP_URL
env.label: Address (optional)
env.description: How people reach ADHX, like https://adhx.example.com. Leave it empty and ADHX remembers the address you set it up from.
